report_title: AnemiaSense Nail Model Explainable AI (XAI) & Validation Report

dataset_specifications.training_target_conversion: Converted to grams per deciliter (g/dL) during target preparation

locked_test_performance_metrics.metric_interpretation: MAE of approximately 1.96 g/dL and negative R-squared indicate substantial regression variance and limited predictive power on the locked hold-out cohort.
locked_test_performance_metrics.clinical_status: Academic Research Prototype — NOT clinically validated for standalone medical diagnosis or hemoglobin measurement.

verified_input_pipeline.aspect_ratio_handling: Aspect-ratio preserved resize with symmetric zero-padding to 224x224

internal_rescaling_layer.critical_requirement: Feed raw [0, 255] RGB float32 pixels. External pre-normalization must NOT be applied to prevent double-normalization.

explainability_xai_specifications.backbone: MobileNetV3Large (nested functional layer within top-level model)
explainability_xai_specifications.target_feature_layer: activation_39 (final hard-swish activation of backbone preceding GlobalAveragePooling2D)
explainability_xai_specifications.checkpoint_identity_notice: The exact training checkpoint utilized for historical explainability trials has not been confirmed independently. Grad-CAM visual heatmaps in this version represent exploratory visual activations of the current mobilenetv3_corrected_preprocessing_best.keras checkpoint and do not constitute clinical proof of subungual microvascular focus.

clinical_and_research_disclaimers.research_warning: Research prototype: This nail-image model provides an experimental estimate and is not a laboratory measurement or medical diagnosis. Its accuracy is limited (locked-test MAE ~1.96 g/dL, negative R²). Do not use this result alone to diagnose anemia, assess severity, or make treatment decisions. Consult a qualified healthcare professional and obtain an appropriate blood test (venous CBC).
clinical_and_research_disclaimers.prescriptions: Strictly prohibited. No iron supplements, pharmaceutical drugs, or treatments may be prescribed from optical screening.
clinical_and_research_disclaimers.modality_independence: The nail model runs 100% independently from the eye model. No synthetic averaging, feature fusion, or joint voting is conducted.
